rblxbuild_minimum_required(VERSION 3.6)

project(ImGuiExample)

set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_library(${RBLXBUILD_PROJECT_NAME} SHARED
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgui.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgui_demo.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgui_draw.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgui_tables.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgui_widgets.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../backends/imgui_impl_android.cpp
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp
  ${ANDROID_NDK}/sources/android/native_app_glue/android_native_app_glue.c
)

set(RBLXBUILD_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS
  "${RBLXBUILD_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -u ANativeActivity_onCreate"
)

target_compile_definitions(${RBLXBUILD_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  IMGUI_IMPL_OPENGL_ES3
)

target_include_directories(${RBLXBUILD_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..
  ${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../backends
  ${ANDROID_NDK}/sources/android/native_app_glue
)

target_link_libraries(${RBLXBUILD_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  android
  EGL
  GLESv3
  log
)
